items.why: Only the placement of the promotional-pricing asterisk and a duplicated footnote changed; prices and the 25% first-year promo are unchanged.

record.short: Bolt now lists collaborator limits: Free is capped at up to 3 collaborators, while Pro and Teams show unlimited collaborators.

items.why: Treasury yield changed from 4.21% to 4.42%, a variable interest rate; plus a “Launch demo” link was added.
Only navigation menu text and line wrapping changed; no pricing change.
Only the rotating customer testimonials changed.
Fixed credit cost tables by video length and model were replaced by typical, work-based credit amounts, and AI-generated video clips are now charged per second.

record.short: Credit costs move from fixed tables to typical amounts that vary with the work: a 30-second video on High (Opus 5.5) goes from 100 to about 90 credits, an AI edit from 60 to about 20 or 50, and AI video clips are charged about 1 (Standard) or 3 (Premium) credits per second.

record.short: The free open-source offer changes from a free Team account to a free Business plan upgrade, now limited to public projects under an OSI-approved license.
